_note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Hero MotoCorp (consolidated, INR crore; Screener basis). Base year FY26A. Forecast profit EXCLUDES the share of associates (Hero FinCorp, Ather Energy, Euler Motors): those stakes are valued separately at market/book in the target (street method). Volume x realisation build by segment in volumeBuild; HEROMOTOCO.ctx.js checks that it reproduces model revenue.

volume._why: Sum of the segment build (volumeBuild). FY27: Apr-Aug 2026 dispatches 27.79 lakh (+17%) but H2 laps the post-GST surge (Q3FY26 +16%, Q4FY26 +24%), Aug-26 was only +2.7% and the 2026 monsoon ended ~13% short; Sep-Mar assumed +3.5%. FY28-29: industry ~5%, Hero helped by scooters, VIDA and premium, dragged by entry bikes.

_revPerUnitWhy: Revenue (incl. parts and services) per vehicle, from the build: FY27 ~5% ICE price increases already taken (4.5% blended since Feb-26), early double-digit EV price rises, mix shift to scooters/EV/125cc/premium and parts +20%; FY28-29 ~3% price plus mix.

volumeBuild._note: FY26 units by segment: SIAM data compiled by Emkay Research (9-Aug-2026; total 64.66 lakh vs the company's 64.69 lakh). Realisations are net revenue per unit (ex-GST, after dealer margin). EV (Q1FY27 EV revenue Rs660 cr on 56,837 units = Rs1.16 lakh; FY26 assumed ~10% lower after early double-digit price rises) and exports (FY26 ~Rs3,500 cr on 4.02 lakh units, CFO, May-2026 call) are disclosed or derived; domestic ICE segment realisations are not disclosed: the FY26 domestic ICE revenue pool (two-wheeler sales Rs39,085 cr less exports and EV) is spread by a price index built from Hero's model-wise GST price cuts of Sep-2025 (HF Deluxe Rs5,805, Splendor+ Rs6,820, Glamour X Rs7,813, Xtreme 125R Rs8,010, Destini 125 Rs7,197, Xoom 110 Rs6,597, Xtreme 160R Rs10,985: cuts are ~7.8% of ex-showroom price, so they scale with price).

segments.name: Domestic motorcycles: entry 100cc (HF Deluxe)
segments._why: Q1FY27 -19%: buyers trade up to Splendor; a tactical HF Deluxe price cut in Jul-26 helped, but a weak monsoon hurts the poorest buyers first.

segments.name: Domestic motorcycles: deluxe 100-110cc (Splendor, Passion)
segments._why: Q1FY27 +20.5% (Splendor +15%, 96% segment share); +2,000/day Splendor capacity; H2 laps the GST surge; long run ~3-4%.

segments.name: Domestic motorcycles: 125cc (Glamour, Super Splendor, Xtreme 125R)
segments._why: Q1FY27 +45%: share recovered from 12.8% (Q1FY26) to 17.7%; more refreshes planned for Q2FY27.

segments.name: Domestic motorcycles: premium >125cc (Xtreme 160/250, Xpulse, Karizma, Harley X440, Mavrick)
segments._why: Q1FY27 +27% but share only 1.5%; new premium head (Aug-26) and launches over the next 12 months. Index ~2x Splendor (Xtreme 160R ~1.6x, Xtreme 250R ~2.1x, X440 higher).

segments.name: Domestic ICE scooters (Destini 125, Xoom, Pleasure+)
segments._why: Q1FY27 +84% (share 6.9%); Destini capacity doubled and Xoom +50%; channel stock half of normal.

segments.name: VIDA electric scooters
segments._why: Apr-Aug 2026 ~1.05 lakh; capacity 30k/month from Aug-26, 45k/month by Q4FY27; ~11% VAHAN share. FY27E ~2.8 lakh.

segments.name: Exports (global business)
segments._why: Q1FY27 +63% but Jul-26 -14% and Aug-26 -24.5%; Apr-Aug +20%. Management aims for ~40% a year; we assume a slowdown.

parts._why: Spare parts revenue FY26 Rs6,592 cr (consolidated; +6%); Q1FY27 parts, accessories and merchandise +30%, July ~25%; GPC 2.0 (Rs750 cr) doubles capacity by end-2027.

other._why: Services (extended warranty, AMC, dealer support: Rs1,371 cr) and other operating revenue incl. export incentives (Rs363 cr) in FY26.

_marginWhy: Consolidated. FY26 14.9% (standalone 14.7%: ICE 17.0% less ~2.3 pts of VIDA losses). Q1FY27 13.3% after a 300 bp gross-margin hit from West Asia-linked commodity inflation (ICE 15.9%). FY27: Q2 cost pressure offset by mix and cost cuts, H2 price increases; VIDA losses ~Rs900 cr. FY28-29: commodity relief, VIDA scale and PLI (13% of EV revenue) take the margin back into the 14-16% medium-term band, at its lower half.
_capexWhy: FY27 guidance Rs1,500 cr (EV, scooter and Splendor capacity, GPC 2.0 parts centre Rs750 cr, Neemrana premium line); FY26 actual Rs1,100 cr; ~2% of revenue thereafter.
_treasuryWhy: Yield on earning treasury (debt funds, bonds, deposits). FY26 treasury income ~Rs1,144 cr (interest Rs293 cr, dividends Rs23 cr, gains on sale Rs128 cr, fair-value gains Rs533 cr before the Rs222 cr Zero Motorcycles write-down, less ~Rs54 cr gain on BSE shares) on ~Rs13,700 cr average earning treasury = 8.4%. FY27 8.5% (Q1FY27 other income Rs460 cr ran above that); 8% from FY28 as FY26-27 mark-to-market gains came with falling yields.
_otherIncomeWhy: Model treasury (cash + investments - borrowings) includes strategic stakes that earn no interest: associates at book (Rs3,901 cr at Mar-26), Euler CCPS Rs210 cr, BSE Rs170 cr, Zero Rs19 cr, Gogoro Rs2 cr = Rs4,302 cr; plus Ather shares bought in Aug-26 (Rs1,758 cr block from GIC + Rs240 cr warrant money) and the Rs720 cr warrant balance assumed paid mid-FY28. Line = -(that year's yield) x average non-earning stakes (FY27 Rs5,468 cr, FY28 Rs6,660 cr, FY29 Rs7,020 cr). Share of associates' profit/loss is excluded from our EPS (stakes valued separately).

stakes._note: Value added to the core P/E (street method). Used by tools/authoring/HEROMOTOCO.stakes.js to set the composite P/E multiple in valuation.blend (engine has no add-on line).
stakes._coreWhy: Base 15.0x: own one-year-forward P/E median since Apr-2021 on EPS before associates and one-offs (16.4x; the house forwardMedian on reported EPS is 16.7x, and 17.0x adjusting only one-offs; no trough years) x (1 - 6.9%), the median de-rating of the seven other auto OEMs at 30-Sep-2026 = 15.2x, rounded to the nearest half-turn. The core basis is used because our EPS excludes associates and the stakes are added at market. Bull 18.0x and bear 12.5x = the 75th and 25th percentiles of the same core history (19.2x, 13.7x) after the same de-rating.

ather._why: NSE close 30-Sep-2026 Rs1,425. Shares: 11,50,83,252 at Mar-26 (AR FY26 note 9A; 29.48% at Jun-26) + 1,18,80,000 bought from GIC at Rs1,480 on 28-Aug-2026 (Rs1,758 cr). Warrants: 76,19,047 at Rs1,260 allotted 25-Aug-2026, 25% paid, Rs945 a share payable on conversion within 18 months (valued at intrinsic value). 20% holding discount = house precedent (Tata Chemicals' Rallis and quoted shares) and Motilal Oswal/Emkay; Choice uses 30%.

hfcl._why: Unlisted. Net assets Rs5,900 cr at Mar-26 (AR FY26 note 9A); Hero owns 40.45% (5,24,31,893 shares). FY26 loss Rs226 cr; IPO approved by SEBI in 2025 but not launched by Sep-26. Valued at 1.0x book less 20% (street range Rs55-215 a share: PL Rs55, Choice Rs59, MOSL Rs89, Emkay Rs215).

others._why: Carrying values at Mar-26 (AR FY26 notes 9A/9B): Euler Motors associate Rs401 cr + Series E CCPS Rs210 cr, BSE shares Rs170 cr, Zero Motorcycles Rs19 cr, Gogoro Rs2 cr.

_interestWhy: FY26 Rs78 cr (leases and subsidiaries' working-capital loans); Q1FY27 Rs21 cr.
_taxWhy: Standalone effective rate 24.4% in FY26 and 25.6% in Q1FY27 (new regime, 25.17%).
_payoutWhy: Policy of 70%+ payout of standalone profit (CFO, May-2026); FY26 DPS Rs185 (interim Rs110 + final Rs75) = 70% of standalone EPS of Rs263.

dcf._why: Cost of equity 6.5% + 0.85 x 6% = 11.6%; net cash, so WACC = Ke. Nominal revenue growth fades to 7% by FY42 (Hero grew revenue 5.2% a year in FY16-26 and 8.9% in FY21-26: ~3% volume + ~4% price/mix) and the EBITDA margin to 14%, the bottom of the 14-16% band, as the EV shift squeezes the ICE franchise; terminal growth 5%.
dcf._betaWhy: Hero's two-year weekly beta has been below 1 (defensive commuter demand, net cash); 0.85 as for Maruti.
dcf._tgWhy: Two-wheeler penetration is still rising, but Hero's core (commuter motorcycles) is losing share of the market to scooters, EVs and premium bikes.

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Rural demand shrugs off the weak monsoon, scooters, VIDA (PLI on the whole range from Dec-26) and premium launches keep gaining share, exports recover; EBITDA margin back to ~15% by FY28. Ather valued at a 10% holding discount.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: The weak 2026 monsoon and the end of the GST boost stall entry and deluxe motorcycles, TVS/Bajaj/Ather out-launch VIDA, commodity costs stay high; margins stuck near 13%. Ather valued at a 30% holding discount and Hero FinCorp at 0.7x book.

methods.name: P/E (15x core) + stakes
methods.why: How the street values Hero: P/E on FY28E/Jun-28E core EPS (16-18x: PL 16x, Motilal Oswal, Emkay and Choice 18x) plus the Ather and Hero FinCorp stakes at a 20-30% holding discount. Ours: 15.0x Sep-28E EPS before associates (own forward median since 2021 on that basis 16.4x x 0.931 sector de-rating) plus stakes of ~Rs870 a share (Ather at the 30-Sep close of Rs1,425 less 20%, Hero FinCorp at 1.0x Mar-26 book less 20%, Euler and other holdings at book). ENGINE WORKAROUND: the engine has no add-on line, so the multiple shown is a composite = 15.0x + stakes per share / Sep-28E EPS of each scenario (set by tools/authoring/HEROMOTOCO.stakes.js). Bull core 18x, bear 12.5x.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.why: 9.0x Sep-28E EBITDA plus model net cash (which carries the stakes at book, not market). Derivation: Hero's 12.9x median trailing EV/EBITDA since Apr-2021 x 0.931 sector de-rating = 12.0x trailing, restated for Sep-28E EBITDA being ~30% above the twelve months to Jun-26 (Rs7,090 cr) = 9.2x, rounded. Bull 10x / bear 8.5x from the 75th/25th percentiles (14.3x, 11.9x) on the same basis.

methods.name: DCF
methods.why: Tests cash-flow support: 15-year FCFF, cost of equity 11.6%, terminal growth 5.5%. Net cash includes the stakes at book value.
